scenes.text: The relay station caught a distress call from a ship that had not launched yet.
scenes.art_prompt: a lone relay station floating in deep space, antenna dishes, retro sci-fi

scenes.text: The voice was calm. It gave coordinates and a hull number still on the drawing board.
scenes.art_prompt: a console glowing with an incoming transmission, dim cockpit, retro sci-fi

scenes.text: Engineers checked the timestamp. The message had been sent thirty years from now.
scenes.art_prompt: a printed timestamp on a control panel, cold light, retro sci-fi

scenes.text: They followed the coordinates anyway, and arrived at the station they were already standing in.
scenes.art_prompt: a crew following coordinates on a star map, tense, retro sci-fi

scenes.text:
The call had come from this room, this console, this crew.
We were not receiving a distress signal. We were sending one.
scenes.art_prompt: an empty console room lit by one screen, quiet and final, retro sci-fi

scenes.text: Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
scenes.art_prompt: a distant relay antenna against the stars, calm and final, retro sci-fi
